extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to find or create a Wikipedia article (new or existing contributors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who want to find, create, or recover a Wikipedia page for a specific title, including account requirements, searching existing content, and handling deleted or delayed pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing or alternative articles
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for the title in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Wikipedia's search to find whether the topic already exists under a different title or spelling before creating a new page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check sister projects for related content
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for the topic on one of Wikipedia's sister projects (Wiktionary, Wikibooks, Wikiquote, Wikisource, Wikiversity, Commons, Wikivoyage, Wikinews, Wikidata, Wikispecies).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If content exists on a sister project it may reduce the need for a separate article or provide material/links to incorporate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account creation and autoconfirmation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not autoconfirmed, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review or request a new article via the appropriate page/process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: If you cannot create the page directly, use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These alternatives allow contributors who are not autoconfirmed or who prefer guided creation to have content reviewed and published by established editors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may be delayed from appearing
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Wait a few minutes or try the purge function to see recently created pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Titles are case sensitive (first character exception)
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider checking different capitalizations and, if appropriate, adding a redirect from the alternative capitalization to the correct title.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page was deleted
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log to understand why it was deleted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the deletion log and linked explanatory pages (e.g., 'Why was the page I created deleted?') to learn whether the topic meets Wikipedia's criteria or how to address issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Finding inbound links can help locate related material, show whether the topic is covered elsewhere, and indicate whether a redirect or article renaming is appropriate.
